rule: Admit every operational route x key case that resolves to real rows in the V6.17 prepared artifacts
rationale: These are the governed operational routes with no exception attached.

rule: Admit SSD Phoenix under its inherited prepared variants Low Volume With Efficiency and Low Volume No Efficiency, labelled LEGACY_VARIANT
rationale: The prepared artifact carries these variants. No governed Organic/Inorganic mapping exists, so none is claimed.

rule: Admit HDD Basilisk despite the catalog marking its serving view empty, under the governed exception CATALOG_SERVING_EMPTY_BUT_OPERATIONAL_ARTIFACT_AVAILABLE
rationale: A working operational artifact exists locally with 202 cases and 75-79 days of history. Source precedence applies.

rule: build_viewer requires history_depth >= 60 distinct dates carrying a non-null actual value
rationale: Local equivalent of the E11 observation-count gate, which required SQL and is not reproducible here. Value chosen from the measured distribution.

rule: build_viewer applies no staleness limit at the recommended default
rationale: Any limit of 60 days or tighter eliminates both Basilisk routes, contradicting D3.

rule: build_forecast is TRUE whenever the case resolves to real forward forecast rows, regardless of history_depth or staleness
rationale: A forecast-only case must never be excluded for having no history. This is the rule that keeps the 298 forecast-only cases in scope.

rule: build_accuracy requires build_viewer AND presence in v6_21b_accuracy_metrics.parquet
rationale: Accuracy metrics are derived from the same backtest pairs the Viewer renders.

rule: Exclude the entity token PROD from the cohort entirely
rationale: PROD is not a forest identifier. It appears in the forecast metadata twice and in the Viewer metadata zero times.

rule: CPU and IOPS routes are declared as SQL_REQUIRED and Memory as NOT_ROUTABLE, with no data row created
rationale: No governed local extract exists. Fabricating a row would be worse than an honest gap.

rule: case_id is route_id plus entity_value, never entity_value alone
rationale: 197 of the 391 series_key tokens exist in more than one route and are different time series.
